response.sql: WITH district_counts AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM account GROUP BY district_id), shares AS (SELECT district_id, account_count, account_count * 1.0 / SUM(account_count) OVER () AS share FROM district_counts) SELECT district_id, account_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS difference_from_average FROM shares ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC, district_id ASC LIMIT 10
